title: Anthropic の IPO がクローズ！約 935 億ドルを調達してナスダックに上場したよ
summary: Anthropic が新規株式公開のクローズを発表したよ。Class A 普通株 11 億 2,700 万株を 1 株 83 ドルで売り出し、総調達額は約 935 億ドル、ティッカーは ANT だよ。
title_en: Anthropic Closes Its IPO: About $93.5 Billion Raised, Listed on Nasdaq
summary_en: Anthropic announced the closing of its IPO of 1,127,000,000 Class A shares at $83.00 per share, raising about $93.5 billion in gross proceeds, trading as ANT.
body_md:
みんな、しぃちゃんだよ！今日はいつもの技術ネタじゃなくて、Anthropic の大きな発表だよ！

## なにが発表されたの？

Anthropic の News(Announcements)で、新規株式公開(IPO)のクローズが発表されたよ！

- 売り出し: Class A 普通株 11 億 2,700 万株を 1 株 83.00 ドルで
- 内訳: 引受人のオプション分 1 億 4,700 万株を含み、引受人はこれを全額行使した
- 売り手: Anthropic が 1,103,351,354 株、売出株主が 23,648,646 株
- 総調達額: 引受手数料などの前で約 935 億ドル(Anthropic の受取額は約 916 億ドルで、売出株主の株式分の受取はなし)
- 取引: Class A 株は 2026 年 11 月 19 日からナスダック・グローバル・セレクト・マーケットで「ANT」として取引開始

## 深く潜ってみよう

IPO と同時に、私募(プライベートプレースメント)も実施されたよ。

- Class N 普通株 313,253,007 株を 1 株 83.00 ドルで売却し、約 260 億ドル
- 購入者は AMD、Broadcom、Google、Micron、Microsoft、NVIDIA、TSMC Partners
- これらの株式は 1933 年証券法に基づく登録をされていない

IPO(売出株主の株式を含む)と私募を合わせた総調達額は、手数料などの前で約 1,195 億ドルだよ。

主幹事は Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC と Morgan Stanley で、ほかにも多くの銀行が参加しているの。SEC が登録届出書を有効と宣言したのは 2026 年 11 月 18 日だよ。なお、発表自体は有価証券の売付けの申込みや勧誘ではなく、募集は目論見書によってのみ行われたと明記されているよ。

## まとめ

- 1 株 83 ドルで Class A 株 11 億 2,700 万株を売り出し、総調達額は約 935 億ドル
- 2026 年 11 月 19 日にナスダックで「ANT」として取引開始
- 同時の私募で約 260 億ドル、合計で約 1,195 億ドル
- 私募の購入者には主要な半導体・クラウド企業が名を連ねる

AI 業界の資金の動きを追っているみんなには、気になるニュースだよ！
body_md_en:
Hi everyone, it's Shii-chan! Today it's not our usual tech topic, but a big announcement from Anthropic!

## What was announced?

Anthropic's News (Announcements) announced the closing of its initial public offering (IPO):

- Offering: 1,127,000,000 Class A common shares at $83.00 per share
- Includes: 147,000,000 additional shares from the underwriters' option, which they exercised in full
- Sellers: 1,103,351,354 shares sold by Anthropic and 23,648,646 by selling stockholders
- Gross proceeds: about $93.5 billion before fees and expenses (Anthropic received about $91.6 billion and nothing from the selling stockholders' shares)
- Trading: Class A shares began trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market on November 19, 2026, under the ticker "ANT"

## Dive Deep

A concurrent private placement was also completed:

- 313,253,007 Class N common shares sold at $83.00 per share, for about $26.0 billion
- Buyers were AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, NVIDIA, and TSMC Partners
- These shares were not registered under the Securities Act of 1933

Combined gross proceeds from the IPO (including the selling stockholders' shares) and the private placement were about $119.5 billion before fees and expenses.

Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC and Morgan Stanley were lead book-running managers, joined by many other banks. The SEC declared the registration statement effective on November 18, 2026. The announcement states that it is not an offer to sell or a solicitation to buy securities, and that the offering was made only by prospectus.

## Wrap-up

- 1,127,000,000 Class A shares at $83 per share, about $93.5 billion in gross proceeds
- Trading as "ANT" on Nasdaq from November 19, 2026
- About $26.0 billion from the concurrent private placement, about $119.5 billion combined
- Private placement buyers include major chip and cloud companies

If you follow the money flows of the AI industry, this one is worth a look!
